gloss: harvest moon; bright full moon (esp. of mid-autumn)

definitions.gloss: harvest moon; bright full moon, especially in mid-autumn
definitions.explanation: A particularly bright and beautiful full moon, traditionally that of the 15th night of the 8th lunar month (mid-autumn). The classic object of {月見|つきみ} (moon viewing).

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{名月|めいげつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}られる→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: We can see the harvest moon tonight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{名月|めいげつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: We gazed at the harvest moon from the veranda.

examples.japanese: ⟦{中秋|ちゅうしゅう}→中秋：27638_chuushuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名月|めいげつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{団子|だんご}→団子：04959_dango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用意|ようい}した→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧。
examples.english: To enjoy the mid-autumn harvest moon, the family prepared dumplings.

notes:
{名|めい} (renowned, fine) + {月|げつ} (moon). Specifically a moon worth celebrating, not just any full moon.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The canonical {名月|めいげつ} is the ⟦{中秋|ちゅうしゅう}→中秋：27638_chuushuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名月|めいげつ}, the harvest moon of the 15th night of the 8th lunar month. A secondary {十三夜|じゅうさんや} ('13th night') moon a month later is also traditionally viewed. Skipping either was considered bad luck ({片見月|かたみつき}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{中秋|ちゅうしゅう}→中秋：27638_chuushuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{名月|めいげつ}: the mid-autumn harvest moon
- {名月|めいげつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}める→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧: to gaze at the harvest moon
- {名月|めいげつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy the harvest moon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{満月|まんげつ}→満月：17598_mangetsu⟧: full moon — neutral astronomical term, any month
- ⟦{十五夜|じゅうごや}→十五夜：24745_juugoya⟧: the 15th night — the night the harvest moon is viewed
- {望月|もちづき}: full moon (literary)
